product_updates.title: Google’s AI Mode can now track flight prices, help book hotels, and more
product_updates.content: The updates indicate that Google is looking position to AI Mode as an AI travel agent of sorts, as it's moving beyond simply helping users find information to actually handling parts of the trip-planning and booking process itself.

product_updates.title: Hugging Face is selling a cute $399 open-source duck robot, Microduck
product_updates.content: Hugging Face is taking orders for the Microduck, a $399 tiny open-source duck robot that developers can train at home out of the box.

product_updates.title: AI’s memory crunch is coming for Android apps
product_updates.content: Google is setting new memory-use limits for Android apps as AI data centers contribute to hardware shortages that could leave lower-cost phones with less memory.

product_updates.title: Plaud’s new earphones come with an eSIM-enabled case for talking to AI agents
product_updates.content: Plaud's new 'agentic' earbuds are priced at $249.

product_updates.title: OpenAI to start showing ads on ChatGPT’s free and Go tiers in India
product_updates.content: OpenAI has more than 100 million weekly active ChatGPT users in India, a huge chunk of whom are on the free or the lower-priced Go tiers.

product_updates.title: Nvidia closes in on Hugging Face acquisition
product_updates.content: Nvidia has reportedly agreed to buy Hugging Face, the popular open source AI hub, for $12.9 billion in a move that would let Nvidia both protect its chip empire and jump back into the cloud business.

product_updates.title: Viral AI startup Instinct has raised $350M at a $2.5B valuation
product_updates.content: The startup is only a year old but it has already generated a massive amount of hype (and money) while also spurring privacy concerns.
